metadata.disclaimer: All rents, commute times, quiet scores and amenity scores are unverified demo estimates created for this prototype, covering 44 areas across Singapore. Commute times for areas and destinations added on 2026-11-11 come from a simple distance model. They are not live listings, market quotes or official transport data. Replace this dataset before any real-world use.
